name: Blessed Sisters
background:
The Blessed Sisters are an elite force of religious warriors equipped with advanced armour and weaponry, which formed under the guidance of the God-Queen, a humble woman suddenly turned into a symbol of hope and resistance.

The sisterhoods act as mediators and rely on diplomacy rather than ruling through force. This has left them without the power and resources of other factions, dependent instead on an ever fragile web of alliances and donations.
backgroundFull:
The rise of a gene-scientist, known to history as the Founder, to supreme ruler of humanity, resulted in a devastating war that soon engulfed Earth and its colonies. As the war grew more devastating, many survivors began to seek a means to escape. A desperate group of refugees commandeered the Founder’s own flagship in order to escape the conflict, leading a fleet of like-minded survivors. 

The Founder caught the refugee fleet and forced an engagement on the edge of known space. Seeking to recapture his ship, his forces lead a number of boarding attacks on the refugee fleet. The Battle Brothers easily outmatched most refugee forces, until a mysterious young woman began to rally them together, displaying an almost supernatural ability to inspire confidence in her forces and fear in her foes. Together they repelled the initial attack, and some began to hope that they might manage to escape. 

Then, a massive wormhole formed around the fleets. In an instant, both fleets were further damaged and separated by the wormhole. The colony fleet was scattered, but many sought out and followed the mysterious woman, looking out for suitable worlds to settle. Under her command, a makeshift fleet settled a few dispersed worlds where her diplomatic skills allowed them to thrive in relative peace. 

Soon after arriving in Sirius, she began to develop psychic abilities. These abilities drew many acolytes and followers, inspiring many to name her their God-Queen. Fearful of the return of the Battle Brothers, the God-Queen decided to focus on training her own band of hand picked warriors. These became the Blessed Sisters and many of them came to truly believe she was divine.

After she sacrificed herself to kill an Avatar of Lust, worship of the God-Queen spread, and many new orders formed in her honour. These orders are often called on to protect allied worlds as peace-keepers and as arbitrators.  The Blessed Sisters rely on volunteers, supplies and other donations from faithful worlds and followers. 

Many worlds take their help for granted, making donations hard to come by, and forcing their orders to go through long periods of fasting and self-reflection to survive. When all else fails, the orders find themselves forced to turn on those they were seeking to protect, and establish martial law in order to survive.

How will you remain a beacon of hope in this grimdark future?

product.description:
An orphaned refugee taken in by the order, Constance would choose to remain with the Blessed Sisters rather than be adopted out to foster parents. From an early age, she saw her convent as her family and sought to extend the same kindness that she had shown her outwards.

Despite this, Constance never imagined herself as a warrior, instead throwing herself into administrative and humanitarian work. Her sincere passion would see her chosen as a junior member of diplomatic missions and exploration missions.

specialRules.name: Devout
specialRules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range
specialRules.description: This model gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting.

specialRules.name: Fast Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Piercing Charge
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) on its weapons when charging.

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Piercing Marksman.

specialRules.name: Bravery Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls.

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Fortified.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +6" range on its weapons when shooting.

specialRules.name: Shred in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Shred on its weapons in melee.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Shred in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Shred on its weapons in melee.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Devout Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Enhanced Devout.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Devout
specialRules.description: If this model has Devout, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Devout (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Precision Shooter Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Bravery Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Spell Conduit
specialRules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Purge
specialRules.description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Guarded Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Guarded once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Precision Target
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Spell Drain
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed, it loses 2 spell tokens.

specialRules.name: Brutal
specialRules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Brutal
specialRules.description: If this model has Brutal, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Brutal (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Heroes with up to Tough(6) may deploy as part of one multi-model unit without another Hero, but must use the unit’s Defense until all other models have been killed. The Hero’s unit, and units within 6” of friendly Heroes with Tough(9) or higher, may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

specialRules.name: Guarded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.
